title: Don't Do This
short_answer: GVC's short list of moves that burn money, fail inspections, or hurt people — each links to the procedure that explains the right way.
summary: You will hear "we always did it like this" on every site. This page is GVC's answer. If a habit below is still happening, it is not toughness — it is unpaid rework or risk.
plain_words: These are the failure modes that cost us real money or real injuries. When you see one happening, stop the habit and open the linked procedure — do not invent a new rule on the truck.
when_to_use: First week on a GVC crew — read once, reference forever
When a veteran habit conflicts with portal / Job Check discipline
Lead teaching a helper what "not GVC" looks like
prerequisites: Know where to find the linked procedures in the Field Guide

steps.title: Money — verbal adds
steps.body: Verbal adds without a stop, photo, and call — see Spotting a Change Order.

steps.title: Money — standing-by
steps.body: Standing-by with no written record — same page; it is a documentation event.

steps.title: Money — other-trade damage
steps.body: Repairing another trade's damage before photographing it — becomes ours the moment we touch it.

steps.title: Money — T&M tickets
steps.body: Unsigned T&M tickets — a negotiation, not a bill.

steps.title: Safety — dust control
steps.body: Sanding or cutting without dust control — Safety Orientation / silica.

steps.title: Safety — bad scaffold
steps.body: Climbing unsafe scaffold "for a minute" — refuse; call the lead.

steps.title: Safety — unknown material
steps.body: Disturbing unknown pre-1981 material — Demolition hard stops.

steps.title: Quality — skip scrape
steps.body: Skipping scrape to sand later — Scraping exists to delete expensive sanding.

steps.title: Quality — paint over dust
steps.body: Paint over dust or bare compound — prime patches; see Paint Touch-Up.

steps.title: Quality — ACT hangers
steps.body: ACT hanger wires on duct — structure only; see Acoustical Ceilings.

steps.title: Quality — Job Check on hope
steps.body: Advancing Job Check on hope — QC Walk first.

steps.title: Rated — fire-wall guess
steps.body: Guessing fire-wall height or type — Fire Walls & Shaftwall.

steps.title: Rated — static firestop
steps.body: Static firestop in a dynamic head-of-wall — Firestopping.

steps.title: Rated — labeled doors
steps.body: Field-modifying a labeled door or frame — stop; supplier or office path.

warnings.title: Toughness is not unpaid rework
warnings.body: "We always did it like this" does not override a failed inspection, a voided firestop, or a CO you never wrote. Link to the right procedure and fix the habit.
